components: On the same internal carrier, swapping supplied effective neutral-current weights between fixed laboratory electron helicities preserves a total width and an electron-only unpolarized pole asymmetry. Their sign difference is observable in polarized production with the stated calibration.
candidates.declared_status: Reanalysis of published polarized and unpolarized summaries and a conditional dictionary contrast, not a derivation of chirality, new couplings or a fit to event data.
missing_bridges: Supply the external particle and helicity mapping, spin-one resonance and factorization, radiation/acceptance treatment and polarization calibration without importing the desired sign.

components: Replay the three calibrated solar-neutrino channel responses with published statistical covariances. Electron and non-electron active flux are distinguished but coherent conversion, classical mixing and a mixed source can give identical rates for matched spectra. Even a two-operation return can be imitated by retained classical memory.
candidates.declared_status: Rounded statistical projection, not the original joint likelihood; no direct determination of coherence, species counts or sterile flux.
missing_bridges: Independently specify source spectra, flavor-specific interactions and detector response. A new phase-sensitive interaction, not another copy of the same three rates, is required to distinguish the matched mechanisms.

components: A relative-baseline spectral statistic removes a common flux rescaling. A bright identity and a uniformly prepared three-cycle with one active phase give identical relative shapes despite unequal absolute rates. An optional hash-pinned replay checks all 990 central PROSPECT-I bins after one overall normalization per period.
candidates.declared_status: Exact toy degeneracy and optional data-table reconstruction, not a reactor exclusion; proposed covariance weights do not exactly reproduce the author null statistic.
missing_bridges: Specify propagation ticks per physical distance and energy, initial phases, response and efficiencies before using real baselines. Resolve the likelihood mismatch before using any significance.

components: Three independent local setting bits are scored on every herald including uniform settings and misses. The existing paired six-rail preparation, sign controls and reflection yield an all-settings score of five eighths. Any classical decision process accessing at most two settings per trial attains at most one half; three contacts can do better.
candidates.declared_status: Conditional synthetic intervention on query access, not a new algorithm, a solar experiment or a rejection of arbitrary classical spreading mechanisms.
missing_bridges: Physically establish the herald precedes independent choices, enforce locality and no global setting leak, calibrate preparation and readout, and account for losses. Intensity-to-event interpretation is not derived.
